accountSecurity.forgotDescription: Enter your email. If a matching account exists, we will send a reset link.
accountSecurity.resetDescription: Choose a new password with at least 10 characters.
accountSecurity.verificationSentDescription: Open the link we sent to activate your account. Request a new link below if needed.
accountSecurity.verificationMetaDescription: Verify the email address for your Luxe Home Estate account.
accountSecurity.verifiedDescription: Your account is active. You can now log in securely.
accountSecurity.invalidVerificationDescription: The link has expired or has already been used.

staffLogin.metaDescription: Log in to the Luxe Home Estate management panel.
staffLogin.title: Management panel login
staffLogin.description: Enter your account details. Access is restricted to authorised staff.
staffLogin.security: Login uses two steps: after your password, enter the code from your authenticator app.
staffLogin.asideDescription: Secure staff access for real estate operations.

verification.title: Verification code
verification.description: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app. If your device is unavailable, use one of your backup codes.
verification.asideDescription: Verification codes are valid only briefly and change for every login.

enrollment.title: Two-factor authentication
enrollment.description: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the code shown in the app.
enrollment.asideTitle: The secret stays on your device
enrollment.asideDescription: The QR code is generated on the server; the authentication secret is not sent to any external service.
enrollment.manualKey: If the QR code cannot be scanned, enter the key manually
enrollment.backupDescription: They will not be shown again. If your phone is unavailable, each code can be used once to log in.
